coordinate_system.profile: X right, Y up, Z front, millimetres. Aperture centers are local to the OLED, not body-local.
coordinate_system.gltf: Actual mesh POSITION accessors decoded; X right, Y front, Z down, metres. Body projection uses [X,-Z]*1000.
coordinate_system.raster: Pixel-edge coordinates, origin upper left. Seam bounds are [start,end), axis is Y on left/right, X on top/bottom.
coordinate_system.body_scale: Body contours independently normalized to published W/H, as pending build.apply_trace. OLED and selfie use the single height-anchored trace.mm_per_px to preserve native aspect.

method.rim: Manually picked narrow dark mechanical gasket between metal shoulder and glossy cover-glass reflection, sampled at side midpoints and top/bottom x=body_width/3. The inner glass reflection is not added to metal. Physical depth/fillet radius is not inferable from a single orthographic raster.
method.seams: Reviewed full rail strips at native resolution. Per-edge half-contrast widths relative to adjacent linearly interpolated metal baseline. Side luminance averages x=3..13 or w-14..w-4; top y=5..17; bottom h-12..h-4. Kept independent left/right results, including half-pixel differences. Widths are raster appearance, not physical insert CAD.
method.selfie: Isolated fully interior alpha>=128 connected component from original installed SDK mask.webp. Pixel-edge bounding-box center, equivalent circular radius sqrt(opaque_area/pi)*trace.mm_per_px. This matches existing 8 Pro method.
method.glb: Decoded POSITION buffers without Blender; actual projected enclosure convex hull compared with normalized trace.body_outline_mm. Flat front shelf measured from enclosure/glass maximum-front-plane X bounds. Does not use front.png or nominal corner_radius metadata.
method.uncertainty: Gasket ±2px normally, ±3px on shaded 8-family bottom edges. Seams ±2px, ±4px for low-contrast Pixel8a. Selfie binary mask ±1px. Artwork and inferred roll are not metrology/CAD.

fields: new report: all seven device measurements, sources, seam coordinates, correction fields, limits and parent generator/helper patch instructions

unchanged_assigned_trace_files: research/skins/pixel-8-pro/trace.json: existing measured selfie cutout already correct
preserved_fields: All fields outside listed changes, including all trace body/OLED outlines and viewport rectangles. No assigned device left unreviewed. No common generator, geometry, verifier, other profiles, public assets, galleries or GLB/BLEND modified.

source_generator_patch_instructions.instruction: Parent-owned: update only Pixel8/8Pro/8a SIDES front values to .75/.65/.85 while retaining rear values3.0/2.2/3.0. For each assigned model set body.front_rail_mm from devices[id].correction; do not apply a generation-wide recipe. Copy measured screen cutouts from assigned trace after seed screen creation so regeneration does not restore1.5mm placeholders. No other seed geometry/materials change.

Parent-owned existing pending independent trace implementation is required: fit body_outline_mm independently to published dimensions, keep traced OLED outline, preserve height-anchored native screen aspect, load trace.screen_cutouts_mm. Cutout centers are screen-local. Do not derive body corners from OLED+bezel. Leave Pixel8a contour acceptance flagged; its SDK art is not consistent with real product photograph.

source_generator_patch_instructions.file: geometry.py or parent common detail helper
source_generator_patch_instructions.instruction: Consume explicit devices[id].antenna_breaks from this report. No uniform six-band template:8/8Pro/8a each8,9/9Pro/9ProXL each6,9a7. Clip patches from actual rolled enclosure, retaining its corner cross-section and front metal shelf; stop at glass gasket and rear body boundary. Each measured band runs transversely across the rail/depth. Treat as surface appearance rather than CAD through-cut. Keep glass continuous and do not add black OLED border.

Separate nonmetallic antenna polymer from metal rail. Preserve existing family rail shader: satin8/8a/9/9a versus polished8Pro/9Pro/9ProXL, and all reviewed finish RGB values. Google product9a image demonstrates light polymer on light finishes and dark polymer on Obsidian; do not use a single black band for every finish. RGB/roughness are uncalibrated. Keep camera and rear logo roles unchanged in this task.

Use measured cutout outer radius and center without alteration. Seat a dark barrel/well and smaller reflective lens inside that aperture, with non-coplanar surfaces and view-dependent reflection. Source raster shows barrel/lens distinctions; internal depth, lens profile and refractive index are visual estimates. Do not place a flat opaque disk above the screen or enlarge the OLED opening to fit arbitrary optics.

Run exports only in parent. Recheck actual GLB vs official independent body contour at<=.10mm, native OLED aspect/UV, cutout positions/radii, visible front metal shelf and absence of coplanar seam/lens artifacts. Re-render actual GLB front plus oblique material view. Current GLBs measured in this report are BEFORE this correction; no fresh visual acceptance claimed.
